$comment: E-058 S2b (delivery_plan_v26.md slice 6a; engineering/roadmap/E-058/S1_FINDINGS.md §4). Applied at write time: tools/block_registry.py passes the whole document to tools/workflow_artifact_validation.validate_workflow_artifact (matched by the file stem block_registry) -- warn-only by default, blocking under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise. tools/block_registry.py::load_registry also checks the structure strictly on every read. Append-only: code never edits or removes a block.
title: campaign_record/block_registry.yaml
description: Validated blocks, appended by the regroup_record stage (orchestrator.regroup_record.enabled) only for a run whose grid idea_status is validated, with no engineering fault, and with artifacts/block_manifest.yaml. A block is usable on any coin; symbols_tested is informational.

revision.description: Bumped on every append (slice 6b reads it for 'changed since last composition').

statuses.description: D-125: append-only block status records, written only by `python tools/block_registry.py status`. A block's current status is its LAST record (none: active); voided blocks are left out of composition and of the readers' registry_summary.

marks.description: Operator notes on blocks, written by hand (first used 2026-10-12 on L1_DAILY_TREND_SMA50_V3_FOLD_B:run_089). Information only: no code reads them.

config_fragment.description: {json_pointer: value} read from the tested base config at block_manifest.yaml block.config_paths.

numbers.description: grid cells {criterion: {variant: {value, threshold, n_windows, n_trades[, per_symbol]}}}

correlation_to_composite.description: E-060 S2: null with orchestrator.composition_runs off (and for a regime block); else the base variant's Pearson correlation with the current composite (value null when there is no composite).

residual_ic.description: E-060 S2: null with orchestrator.composition_runs off (and for a regime block); else the base variant's residual-IC record (tools/residual_ic.py) the grid's residual_ic cell was evaluated on.

timeframe.description: E-060 S2 (composition_runs only): the exact bar size the block was validated on (the protocol's timeframe).

timeframe_category.description: E-060 S2 operator decision 3: high <= 15min; medium > 15min and < 1h; low >= 1h and < 1d; daily >= 1d.
